source: Public M7.02 core in F/spec; explicit M7.02 follow-up. No private source used.
relationshipToCatalogue: Keeps the original single-choice contract unchanged as historical design. This explicitly commissioned runtime variant adds ungraded argument/research drafts and one optional bounded claim selection; it is not a whole-text assessment.

material.substance: uncharged X; no chemical change, binding or redistribution to another compartment
material.conditions: initial net uptake into comparable membrane compartments; same concentrations, temperature and membrane area; only presence of P differs; energy dependence and energy source not investigated

scope: Only chosen authored claims about the rate evidence and its energy limit. Free argument and proposed investigation are never parsed, graded, or counted toward success.

rate.reason: Higher initial net uptake with P is the provided finding, not a claim about energy.

energy_open.reason: Energy dependence was not investigated. No ATP consumption or direct hydrolysis by P is proven.

atp_pump.reason: A claimed proof of an ATP pump contradicts the actual evidential scope. This does not prove that P cannot use ATP.

active_proven.reason: A higher rate with P does not entail energy-coupled active transport.

passive_proven.reason: Downhill transport is compatible with passive transport but these data do not exclude coupling or prove its absence.

other.reason: The pupil explicitly states the offered selection does not represent their claim. No interpretation of free writing is invented.

aggregation.incorrect: At least one selected, specifically unjustified proof claim; correct selected parts remain green.
aggregation.clarify: Other or unknown string ID, unless a known incorrect selected claim supplies an independent contradiction.
aggregation.partial: Only one of rate/energy_open selected; this does not negate that correct individual part.
aggregation.correct: Both required claims selected, no incorrect or unassessed claim. Only this selection is confirmed.
aggregation.technical: Invalid input shape, duplicates, or foreign/changed context; no biological judgment. No prefix is evaluated.

feedback: Recognized selected claim + specific reason + exactly one next thinking/revision action + optional staged help. No full model explanation as initial error response.
history: Criteria/check or first comparison freezes the actual draft before disclosure, even when empty. Later writing is revision; empty snapshot is not called an independent first answer. Earlier hints and uncertain reload history are recorded separately and never change scientific correctness. Reset preserves seen help in this session.
persistence: None for this block: no raw text, choices, help ledger or success receipt persisted/transmitted; existing eight progress metadata untouched.
limits: No independent acceptance or classroom certification
